entries.en: া (a-kar): adds 'a' as in 'father' after the consonant
entries.notes: Bare sign: া (U+09BE), name a-kar (আ-কার). Written to the right of the consonant.
Bare sign: ি (U+09BF), name hroshsho i-kar (হ্রস্ব ই-কার). Typed after the consonant but DRAWN to its left. Same sound as ী.
Bare sign: ী (U+09C0), name dirgho i-kar (দীর্ঘ ই-কার). Written to the right. Same sound as ি. কী also means 'what?'
Bangladesh is a land of rivers: পদ্মা, মেঘনা, যমুনা.
Bare sign: ু (U+09C1), name hroshsho u-kar (হ্রস্ব উ-কার). Below the letter; joins differently after র, হ, শ, গ (রু, হু, শু, গু). Same sound as ূ.
Bare sign: ূ (U+09C2), name dirgho u-kar (দীর্ঘ উ-কার). Same sound as ু. After র it becomes রূ.
Bare sign: ৃ (U+09C3), name ri-kar (ঋ-কার). The sign form of ঋ. After হ it looks like হৃ.

entries.en: ে (e-kar): adds 'e' as in 'bed' or 'ay' as in 'say'
entries.notes: Bare sign: ে (U+09C7), name e-kar (এ-কার). Drawn to the LEFT of the consonant. কে also means 'who?'. Sometimes said æ (দেখা dækha).
Bare sign: ৈ (U+09C8), name oi-kar (ঐ-কার). ে with an extra flick on top; also drawn to the left.
তৈরি করা = to make; আমি তৈরি = I'm ready. তৈরী is an older, non-standard spelling (Bangla Academy: তৈরি).

entries.en: ো (o-kar): adds 'o' as in 'go'; wraps around the consonant
entries.notes: Bare sign: ো (U+09CB; canonically ে U+09C7 + া U+09BE, stored precomposed here per NFC). Name o-kar (ও-কার).

entries.en: ৌ (ou-kar): adds 'ou' as in 'low'; wraps around the consonant
entries.notes: Bare sign: ৌ (U+09CC; ে + ৗ U+09D7, stored precomposed per NFC). Name ou-kar (ঔ-কার).
